payload.description:
## Trigger

When an AI coding agent runs a command in its shell, I want plain cat and cd, so I can trust the exit status and error text of standard commands.

CLAUDECODE=1 is set in the Bash tool shell, but /proc/<pid>/environ of each claude process has no CLAUDECODE, so a guard on it at snapshot time is not proven.
